name: Integration - LLM Provider Selection and Initialization
description: Verifies that the agent initializes the correct LLM client based on the LLM_PROVIDER environment variable and raises an error for unsupported providers.
input: Environment variable LLM_PROVIDER set to 'openai' and then to an unsupported value.
output: Agent initializes AsyncOpenAI client for 'openai' and raises ValueError for unsupported providers.
success_criteria: AsyncOpenAI client is initialized when LLM_PROVIDER is 'openai'
ValueError is raised for unsupported LLM_PROVIDER values
error_scenarios: No error raised for unsupported provider
